doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Ma Rainey calls and Ory's work behind her
summary: Ory describes outlasting other players at a Ma Rainey session and confirms he recorded behind her.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Ma Rainey came there with a call, a call over the blues singer, you know. Some could sing, some couldn't. And all the bands got tired. But Lil and I, myself... And you kept going. They'd leave and go send a call up a trumpet player or a clarinet player, Johnny Dyson play. They all burned out. I stood there and made the money.
Did you record with Ma Rainey once? There was a rumor that you'd made, actually made records with Ma Rainey yourself.
Not my band, but I record with the group.
Yeah, that's right. I've never heard the records.
